regimes.post: اشتهای ریسک گسترده؛ Carry و High-beta FX در اولویت؛ Hedging ارزان است
regimes.post_en: Broad risk appetite; Carry and High-beta FX first; hedging is cheap

regimes.post: سوگیری به ریسک با انتخاب‌گری؛ Carry با Sizing معمول
regimes.post_en: Lean into risk selectively; Carry with normal sizing

regimes.post: سیگنال‌ها متناقض‌اند؛ Relative value و Sizing کوچک‌تر
regimes.post_en: Signals conflict; relative value and smaller sizing

regimes.post: کاهش Carry و Leverage؛ سوگیری به Safe haven متناسب با Regime type
regimes.post_en: Cut Carry and leverage; tilt to Safe havens according to the regime type

regimes.post: Capital preservation؛ کاهش Gross؛ Liquidity و Hedging؛ منتظر تأیید Reversal
regimes.post_en: Capital preservation; cut gross; liquidity and hedging; wait for a confirmed reversal

types.sig: بازده 10Y و 2Y پایین می‌آید، Breakeven و نفت افت می‌کنند و JPY قوی می‌شود.
types.long: JPY و CHF؛ USD در برابر Commodity FX و EM؛ EUR در برابر AUD و NZD
types.short: High-beta carry: AUD, NZD, NOK, ZAR, BRL, MXN
types.hedge: خرید USDJPY puts و AUDJPY puts؛ کاهش Carry؛ افت Front-end yields، Rate differential با USD را کم می‌کند
types.inv: برگشت بازده‌ها به بالا همراه با بهبود Growth data (PMI, Payrolls)
types.sig_en: 10Y and 2Y yields fall, breakevens and oil drop, and JPY strengthens.
types.long_en: JPY and CHF; USD vs commodity FX and EM; EUR vs AUD and NZD
types.short_en: High-beta carry: AUD, NZD, NOK, ZAR, BRL, MXN
types.hedge_en: Buy USDJPY puts and AUDJPY puts; cut Carry; falling front-end yields narrow the rate differential with USD
types.inv_en: Yields turn back up alongside improving growth data (PMI, Payrolls)

types.sig: نفت، Breakeven و بازده اسمی بالا می‌روند؛ JPY ضعیف می‌شود و Treasuries دیگر Hedge سهام نیستند.
types.long: USD؛ Energy exporters (NOK, CAD) در برابر Energy importers
types.short: Energy importers: JPY, EUR, KRW, INR
types.hedge: کاهش Duration؛ JPY در این رژیم Safe haven قابل‌اعتمادی نیست؛ USD و Cash
types.inv: افت نفت و Breakeven؛ منفی شدن دوباره Stock–bond correlation
types.sig_en: Oil, breakevens and nominal yields rise; JPY weakens and Treasuries stop hedging equities.
types.long_en: USD; energy exporters (NOK, CAD) vs energy importers
types.short_en: Energy importers: JPY, EUR, KRW, INR
types.hedge_en: Cut duration; JPY is not a reliable Safe haven in this regime; USD and cash
types.inv_en: Oil and breakevens fall; stock–bond correlation turns negative again

types.sig: Real yield و بازده 2Y بالا می‌روند ولی Breakeven نه؛ USD قوی و JPY ضعیف است.
types.long: USD در برابر Low-yielders و EM با Current account deficit
types.hedge: کاهش EM carry؛ Horizon کوتاه‌تر؛ USD calls
types.inv: افت Real yield یا لحن Dovish از Fed
types.sig_en: Real yields and 2Y yields rise but breakevens do not; USD strong, JPY weak.
types.long_en: USD vs low-yielders and EM with current-account deficits
types.hedge_en: Cut EM carry; shorter horizon; USD calls
types.inv_en: Real yields fall or the Fed turns dovish

types.sig: USD در برابر همه جهش می‌کند، CP spread باز می‌شود و EM و Credit هم‌زمان زیر فشارند.
types.long: USD در برابر تقریباً همه (حتی EUR و JPY)
types.short: High-beta EM (ZAR, BRL, MXN, KRW) و AUD
types.hedge: De-leveraging و نگهداری USD liquidity؛ پایش Cross-currency basis و Fed swap lines
types.inv: آرام شدن Funding spreads یا مداخله Central banks
types.sig_en: USD jumps against everything, the CP spread widens, and EM and Credit come under pressure together.
types.long_en: USD vs almost everything (even EUR and JPY)
types.short_en: High-beta EM (ZAR, BRL, MXN, KRW) and AUD
types.hedge_en: De-leverage and hold USD liquidity; watch cross-currency basis and Fed swap lines
types.inv_en: Funding spreads calm down or central banks intervene

types.sig: JPY جهش می‌کند، AUDJPY و EM FX سقوط می‌کنند، Volatility بالا می‌رود و CHF قوی می‌شود.
types.long: JPY و CHF در برابر High-yielders
types.short: MXN, BRL, ZAR, AUD, NZD در برابر JPY
types.hedge: کاهش Gross؛ با Position unwind نجنگید؛ JPY می‌تواند Overshoot کند
types.inv: آرام شدن Volatility و تثبیت USDJPY
types.sig_en: JPY spikes, AUDJPY and EM FX slump, volatility rises and CHF strengthens.
types.short_en: MXN, BRL, ZAR, AUD, NZD vs JPY
types.hedge_en: Cut gross exposure; don't fight the position unwind; JPY can overshoot

types.sig: US equities، Treasuries و USD هم‌زمان افت می‌کنند و Non-US safe havens قوی می‌شوند.
types.long: EUR, CHF, JPY, SEK و Gold
types.hedge: پایش Treasury auctions و Term premium؛ US policy risk
types.inv: بازگشت Capital flows به USD یا آرام شدن US policy risk
types.sig_en: US equities, Treasuries and USD fall together while non-US safe havens strengthen.
types.long_en: EUR, CHF, JPY, SEK and Gold
types.hedge_en: Watch Treasury auctions and the term premium; US policy risk
types.inv_en: Capital flows return to USD or US policy risk fades

types.sig: HY، IG و EM spreads باز می‌شوند و Credit هم‌پای Volatility یا بدتر از آن است؛ Correlation دارایی‌های ریسکی بالاست.
types.long: JPY و CHF؛ USD در برابر EM
types.short: High-beta EM و Credit-sensitive FX (AUD, NZD, ZAR)
types.hedge: کاهش Tail risk؛ پایش EM spreads، Defaults و Leveraged sectors (مثل Private credit)
types.inv: Spread tightening همراه با ثبات Equities
types.sig_en: HY, IG and EM spreads widen and Credit is as weak as volatility or worse; risk-asset correlation is high.
types.long_en: JPY and CHF; USD vs EM
types.short_en: High-beta EM and credit-sensitive FX (AUD, NZD, ZAR)
types.hedge_en: Cut Tail risk; watch EM spreads, Defaults and Leveraged sectors (e.g. Private credit)

types.sig: Volatility پایین، Rates و Inflation آرام، Credit قوی و Equities صعودی.
types.long: High-yield carry (MXN, BRL, ZAR, INR) در برابر JPY, CHF, EUR
types.hedge: Short vol فقط با احتیاط؛ پایش Crowded positioning
types.sig_en: Low volatility, calm rates and inflation, strong Credit and rising equities.
types.long_en: High-yield carry (MXN, BRL, ZAR, INR) vs JPY, CHF, EUR
types.hedge_en: Short vol only with caution; watch crowded positioning

types.sig: Growth و Inflation با هم بالا می‌روند: بازده‌ها، Breakeven و نفت بالا و Equities صعودی.
types.long: Commodity FX (AUD, NOK, CAD, BRL, ZAR)
types.hedge: مراقب تبدیل شدن به Inflation shock باشید (افت Equities همراه با بازده بالا)
types.sig_en: Growth and inflation rise together: yields, breakevens and oil up, equities rising.
types.long_en: Commodity FX (AUD, NOK, CAD, BRL, ZAR)
types.hedge_en: Watch for a turn into an inflation shock (equities falling while yields rise)
types.inv_en: Commodities fall or a rates shock

types.sig: USD ضعیف، EM FX قوی و شرایط Credit و Funding آسان است.
types.inv: USD spike یا Tighter financial conditions
types.sig_en: Weak USD, strong EM FX, and easy credit and funding conditions.
types.hedge_en: Beware of a sudden USD rebound
types.inv_en: USD spike or tighter financial conditions

types.sig: Volatility بسیار پایین، JPY ضعیف، AUDJPY و EM قوی و Credit محکم.
types.long: Carry basket (High-yielders در برابر JPY و CHF) با Sizing بر اساس Carry-to-vol
types.hedge: خرید JPY calls ارزان برای Left-tail hedge
types.inv: FX vol spike یا تغییر سیاست BoJ
types.sig_en: Very low volatility, weak JPY, strong AUDJPY and EM, and firm Credit.
types.long_en: Carry basket (high-yielders vs JPY and CHF), sized by carry-to-vol
types.hedge_en: Buy cheap JPY calls as a left-tail hedge
types.inv_en: FX vol spike or a BoJ policy shift
